overview.headline: How pH measures acidity in water and why it matters for quality

keyPoints.point: Students learn that pH is a measure of how acidic water is on a scale where 7 is neutral.
keyPoints.quote: pH is a measure of how acidic/basic water is.

keyPoints.point: Students learn that each pH number represents a 10-fold change in acidity of the water.
keyPoints.quote: Each number represents a 10-fold change in the acidity/basicness of the water.

keyPoints.point: Students learn that a solution must be aqueous and contain water to have a pH value.
keyPoints.quote: for a solution to have a pH, it has to be aqueous (contains water).

keyPoints.point: Students learn that water pH determines solubility and whether nutrients remain available for aquatic life.
keyPoints.quote: The pH of water determines the solubility (amount that can be dissolved in the water)

keyPoints.point: Students learn that mine-drainage water at pH 2 is 100,000 times more acidic than neutral water and can harm fish.
keyPoints.quote: this mine-drainage water would be 100,000 times more acidic than neutral water

keyTerms.gloss: measure of how acidic or basic an aqueous solution is based on hydrogen ions
keyTerms.quote: pH is a measure of how acidic/basic water is.

keyTerms.gloss: relative amount of acidic ions that changes with each pH unit in water
keyTerms.quote: Each number represents a 10-fold change in the acidity/basicness of the water.

keyTerms.gloss: solution that contains water as the solvent for hydrogen ions
keyTerms.quote: for a solution to have a pH, it has to be aqueous (contains water).

keyTerms.gloss: units reported for pH where each number reflects a tenfold change
amount of a chemical that can be dissolved in water at a given pH
keyTerms.quote: The pH of water determines the solubility (amount that can be dissolved in the water)

keyTerms.gloss: precipitation that is more acidic than normal rain and can harm the environment
keyTerms.quote: You can see that acid rain can be very acidic, and it can affect the environment in a negative way.
